scope.reference: Setup: same binary both changes off/on. Applications: stock Playwright and both custom policies. All original test bodies retained.
scope.timing: Complete original-watchdog elapsed includes fixture/runner/browser startup and natural observed drain. Charged CPU is measured inside the owner interval: module imports and final report/watchdog drain are excluded. This is not complete-capture CPU custody.
scope.policy: Same4core quota,CPUs0–5,8GiB,swap0,Nice10. Native arms retain physical renderer reuse, classic uncapped early-idle scheduler, lazy VAAPI and source-cache off. Audit disabled during suite/application timing.
scope.inputScope: Flat manifest verifies selected inputs. Original offline corpus is separately byte/hash validated against its prepared manifest during preparation, serving and verification; offline corpus directories are absent from the flat hash list.

setupPlan.hypothesis: Combine the independently measured 250us first retirement retry with the independently measured1ms uncapped timer grid. The former removed single-worker waiting; the latter reduced four-worker CPU. Composition must be measured directly, not inferred from component ratios.
setupPlan.mechanism: Identical retained source implementations from early-retirement-recheck and paced-uncapped-frames. No parameter search. Both off versus both on in the same binary. Audit logging off for timing.
setupPlan.functionalPlan: Both arms: seven worker/ fresh-successor pairs; three motion/rAF/trusted-click/pixel/fresh-state contexts. Then unchanged15-test setup preflight per worker/policy.
setupPlan.performancePlan: Unchanged240-test setup body at workers1/4, two reversed blocks: baseline/candidate then candidate/baseline. Original owner clocks, full startup/drain, same4CPUquota/6CPUaffinity/8GiB/swap0 policy.
setupPlan.advancement: All functional controls and at least10% lower complete elapsed in all four setup comparisons, no charged CPU regression above5% in any comparison and at least20% lower charged CPU in both four-worker comparisons. If passed, declare separate original TodoMVC/SVGOMG comparison before app timing. No adoption or final acceptance from setup alone.
setupPlan.remainingCoverage: Timer boundary/multiple-observer/GPU-recovery native enabled tests, forced worker registry races, broader media/artifact coverage remain open.

applicationPlan.prerequisite: Combination passed all four declared setup comparisons and selected worker/frame controls.
arms: same custom binary with both candidate changes off
same custom binary with pacing and early recheck on
applicationPlan.scope: Twelve functional preflight captures followed by24 timed captures: TodoMVC24 original tests and SVGOMG6 original tests, workers1/4, two reversed arm orders.540 total original outcomes if all pass. No test body changes or retries. Complete owner includes service/runner/browser startup and shutdown.
applicationPlan.advancement: Retain as a candidate for broader conformance/family evaluation if at least one application improves complete elapsed by at least10% in both worker counts and both orders, with no comparison in either application regressing elapsed or chargedCPU by more than5%. This is not adoption or the final2x goal; record stock Playwright ratios separately.
applicationPlan.resourcePolicy: Same4core quota, CPUs0–5,8GiB,swap0,Nice10. No concurrent measurements. Input hashes and exact original corpus outcomes/request contracts checked.

applicationDecision.interpretation: Direct composition observations; not a multiplication of component speedups. Two reversed blocks cannot establish final confidence.
